verses.text: ALEPH Blessed are those who live with integrity and walk by the LORD’s instruction.
Blessed are those who keep his teachings and seek him with their whole hearts.
They do no wrong. They walk in his ways.
You gave your instructions so we’d follow them all the way.
If only I could stay steady and keep your statutes!
Then I wouldn’t hang my head in shame when I look at all your commands.
I’ll thank you with an honest heart as I learn your righteous judgments.
I’ll keep your statutes. Please don’t leave me altogether. BETH
How can a young person stay on a clean path? By living by your word.
I’ve looked for you with my whole heart. Don’t let me drift from your commands.
I’ve tucked your word away in my heart so I won’t sin against you.
Blessed are you, LORD. Teach me your statutes.
I’ve said out loud every judgment you’ve spoken.
I find as much joy in following your teachings as I would in having every kind of wealth.
I’ll sit with your instructions and pay close attention to your ways.
I’ll take joy in your statutes. I won’t forget your word. GIMEL
Be good to your servant so I can live and follow your word.
Open my eyes so I can see the wonders in your instruction.
I’m a stranger here on earth. Don’t hide your commands from me.
My whole soul aches for your judgments all the time.
You’ve rebuked the proud, those under a curse who wander from your commands.
Take away the insults and contempt, because I’ve kept your teachings.
Even when rulers sit together and talk trash about me, your servant will keep thinking about your statutes.
Your teachings are my joy. They’re the ones I go to for advice. DALETH
I’m down in the dust. Bring me back to life as you promised!
I told you how I’ve been living, and you answered me. Teach me your statutes.
Help me understand what you’re teaching me through your instructions. Then I’ll think about the wonders you’ve done.
My soul is worn out from sorrow. Give me strength as you promised.
Keep me off the path of lies. Be gracious and teach me your law.
I’ve chosen the way of truth. I’ve set your judgments right in front of me.
I’m holding tight to your teachings, LORD. Don’t let me be put to shame.
I run down the path of your commands because you’ve set my heart free. HE
Teach me, LORD, how to live by your statutes, and I’ll keep them to the end.
Give me understanding so I can keep your law and follow it with my whole heart.
Lead me down the path of your commands. That’s where I find joy.
Turn my heart toward your teachings and away from chasing gain for myself.
Turn my eyes away from things that aren’t worth my attention. Give me life in your ways.
Keep the promise you made to your servant, so people will stand in awe of you.
Take away the disgrace I dread, because your judgments are good.
Look how I long for your instructions! Bring me back to life in your righteousness. VAV
Let your faithful love reach me too, LORD. Save me as you promised.
Then I’ll have an answer for people who mock me, because I trust what you’ve said.
Don’t take the words of truth out of my mouth, because I’ve put my hope in your judgments.
I’ll keep following your law, always and forever.
I’ll walk freely, because I’ve gone looking for your instructions.
I’ll talk about your teachings even in front of kings, and I won’t be put to shame.
I’ll take joy in your commands, because I love them.
I reach out for the commands I love. I’ll keep thinking about your statutes. ZAYIN
Remember what you told me, your servant. You gave me something to hope for.
Here’s what comforts me when I’m hurting: your word has brought me back to life.
The proud won’t stop mocking me, but I won’t veer away from your instruction.
I remember the judgments you gave long ago, LORD, and I find comfort in them.
I’m burning with anger because the wicked have walked away from your law.
Your statutes are the songs I sing in the place where I’m staying.
At night I remember your name, LORD, and I keep your law.
This is how I live: I follow your instructions. HETH
The LORD is my share. I’ve promised to live by what you say.
I’ve asked for your favor with my whole heart. Show me mercy, just as you promised.
I thought about where I was headed and turned my feet back toward your teachings.
I’m moving fast to obey your commands. I won’t put it off.
The wicked tie me up with their ropes, but I won’t forget your law.
I’ll get up at midnight to thank you for your righteous judgments.
I’m a friend to everyone who fears you and follows your instructions.
LORD, your faithful love fills the earth. Teach me your statutes. TETH
You’ve been good to me, your servant, just as you promised, LORD.
Teach me good judgment and help me learn, because I trust your commands.
Before I went through trouble, I wandered off. Now I do what you say.
You’re good, and you do good. Teach me your statutes.
The proud have smeared my name with lies. I’ll keep your instructions with my whole heart.
Their hearts have gone numb, thick as fat, but I take joy in your law.
That hardship did me good. It helped me learn your statutes.
The law you spoke is worth more to me than thousands of pieces of gold and silver. YODH
Your hands made me and gave me shape. Give me understanding so I can learn your commands.
People who fear you will see me and be glad, because I’ve put my hope in your word.
LORD, I know your judgments are right. Even when you brought me hardship, you were faithful.
Let your faithful love be my comfort, just as you promised me, your servant.
Let your tender mercy reach me so I can live, because your law is where I find joy.
Put the proud to shame for knocking me down without cause. I’ll keep thinking about your instructions.
Let the people who fear you turn to me, so they can know your teachings.
Let my heart stay true to your decrees so I won’t be put to shame. KAPF
My soul is worn out waiting for you to save me. I put my hope in your word.
My eyes are worn out looking for your promise to come true. I ask, “When will you comfort me?”
I’m like a wineskin shriveled in the smoke, but I haven’t forgotten your statutes.
How many days do I have left? When will you judge the people who keep coming after me?
Proud people have dug pits for me, going right against your law.
Every command you give is trustworthy. They’re wrong to hound me like this. Help me!
They almost wiped me off the earth, but I held on to your instructions.
Keep me alive in your faithful love so I can obey the teachings you spoke. LAMEDH
LORD, your word stands firm in heaven forever.
Your faithfulness holds through every generation. You set the earth in place, and it’s still here.
Your laws still stand today, because everything serves you.
If I hadn’t found joy in your law, my suffering would’ve finished me.
I’ll never forget your instructions. Through them you gave me life again.
I belong to you. Save me, because I’ve been seeking your instructions.
The wicked are waiting to destroy me. I’ll keep my mind on your teachings.
I’ve seen a limit even to what seems perfect. Your commands have no limit. MEM
I love your law so much! I think about it all day long.
Your commands make me wiser than my enemies, because I carry them with me everywhere.
I understand more than all my teachers because I keep turning your teachings over in my mind.
I understand more than my elders because I’ve put your instructions into practice.
I’ve kept my feet off every road that leads to evil so I can live by your word.
I haven’t turned away from your judgments, because you’re the one who taught me.
Your promises taste so sweet to me, sweeter than honey on my tongue!
Your instructions help me see clearly. That’s why I hate every path built on lies. NUN
Your word is a lamp for my feet and a light on the path ahead.
I’ve sworn an oath and stand by it. I’ll follow your righteous judgments.
I’m hurting badly, LORD. Bring me back to life as you promised.
Please accept the praise I offer freely, LORD, and teach me your judgments.
My life is always on the line, but I won’t forget your law.
The wicked have set a trap for me, but I haven’t strayed from your instructions.
I’ve taken your teachings as my inheritance forever, because they fill my heart with joy.
I’ve made up my mind to live by your statutes forever, right to the end. SAMEKH
I hate double-minded people, but I love your law.
You’re my hiding place and my shield. I put my hope in your word.
Get away from me, you evildoers, so I can keep my God’s commands.
Hold me up as you promised, so I can live. Don’t let the hope I’ve put in you leave me ashamed.
Hold me steady and I’ll be safe. I’ll keep paying attention to your statutes.
You reject everyone who strays from your statutes, because their lies get them nowhere.
You skim away the wicked of the earth like waste from molten metal. That’s why I love your teachings.
I tremble all over in fear of you. Your judgments fill me with dread. AYIN
I’ve done what’s just and right. Don’t leave me in the hands of those who oppress me.
Make sure your servant is safe. Don’t let the proud push me around.
My eyes are worn out looking for your rescue, waiting for your righteous promise.
Treat me with your faithful love, and teach me your statutes.
I’m your servant. Give me understanding so I can know your teachings.
LORD, it’s time to act. They’re breaking your law.
That’s why I love your commands more than gold, more than the purest gold.
I know every instruction you give is right. I hate every path built on lies. PE
Your teachings are full of wonder. That’s why I keep them with my whole soul.
When your words open up, light comes in. They help people with no experience understand.
I opened my mouth wide and gasped for breath, longing for your commands.
Turn toward me and show me mercy, like you always do for people who love your name.
Keep my steps steady in your word. Don’t let any wrongdoing take control of me.
Free me from people who oppress me, so I can follow your instructions.
Let your face shine on your servant. Teach me your statutes.
Tears run down my face like streams because people don’t keep your law. TZADHE
You’re righteous, LORD, and your judgments are right.
You gave your teachings in righteousness. Every one of them can be trusted.
My passion wears me out because my enemies brush off your words.
Your promises have stood up to every test, and I love them.
People look down on me and think I’m nobody. I still remember your instructions.
Your righteousness lasts forever, and your law is truth.
Trouble and anguish have caught up with me, but your commands are still my joy.
Your teachings are right forever. Give me understanding so I can live. QOPH
I’m calling with my whole heart. Answer me, LORD! I’ll keep your statutes.
I’m calling to you. Save me! I’ll follow your teachings.
I’m up before dawn crying for help. I put my hope in your words.
Through the watches of the night I stay wide awake, thinking about your word.
Hear my voice in your faithful love. LORD, give me life as your judgments promise.
People who chase after evil are closing in. They’re miles from your law.
But you’re close, LORD, and every command you give is true.
I learned long ago from your teachings that you set them in place forever. RESH
See what I’m going through and rescue me, because I haven’t forgotten your law.
Take up my case and buy me back! Bring me to life as you promised.
The wicked are far from rescue because they never look to your statutes.
LORD, your compassion is great. Give me life in keeping with your judgments.
I have plenty of enemies, and plenty of people are after me. I haven’t turned away from your teachings.
I see people break faith, and it makes me sick, because they pay no attention to your word.
See how much I love your instructions. LORD, bring me back to life in your faithful love.
Everything you say is true. Every one of your righteous judgments lasts forever. SIN AND SHIN
Rulers have come after me for no reason, but it’s your words that make my heart stand in awe.
I celebrate your word like someone who’s just found a pile of treasure.
I hate lies with everything in me. I love your law.
Seven times a day I praise you for your righteous judgments.
People who love your law have deep peace. Nothing trips them up.
LORD, I’ve put my hope in your rescue and followed your commands.
I’ve kept your teachings with my whole soul. I love them so much.
I’ve followed your instructions and your teachings, because you see every path I take. TAV
Let my cry reach you, LORD. Give me understanding as you promised.
Let my plea come before you. Rescue me as you promised.
Let praise pour from my lips, because you teach me your statutes.
Let my tongue sing about your word, because everything you command is right.
Have your hand ready to help me, because I’ve chosen your instructions.
I’ve been longing for you to save me, LORD. Your law is where I find joy.
Let me live so I can praise you. Let your judgments help me.
I’ve wandered off like a lost sheep. Come find your servant. I haven’t forgotten your commands.
